hypotheses.title: Dimensionless Options Volatility Premium and Accrual-Free Forward Yields
hypotheses.economic_rationale: By scaling options implied volatility relative to realized volatility as a dimensionless ratio (IV / (HV + 0.01)), we isolate relative volatility mispricing across equities while preventing single-stock volatility shocks from distorting cross-sectional weights. Concurrently, tapping sell-side consensus forward Cash Flow Per Share (anl4_afv4_cfps_mean) and Dividend Per Share (anl4_afv4_div_mean) yields exploits authentic operational cash generation and defensive capital returns that are immune to accounting accrual shifts. Each candidate utilizes intra-subindustry ranking and 15% 3-day reversal stabilization to dampen turnover and maintain Sharpe >= 1.50 while guaranteeing self-correlation < 0.50 against Alpha 10.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if options implied volatility accurately anticipates persistent future turbulence or if forward cash flow estimates diverge sharply from realized quarterly cash receipts.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1: Dimensionless Options Variance Risk Premium (VRP) ratio with 15% 3-day reversal stabilizer to eliminate weight concentration and elevate Sharpe > 1.25
Candidate 2: 1-year consensus forward Cash Flow Per Share yield with 15% 3-day reversal stabilizer in TOP1000
Candidate 3: 1-year consensus forward Dividend yield trajectory with 15% 3-day reversal stabilizer in TOP1000
